summary: Iteration 4 fully verified end-to-end. Backend: 18/18 new tests pass in ~14s covering version=1.3.0, /api/recipes shape (8 recipes with template/styles/weights_hint summing ~1), /api/orchestrate response now includes cost_estimate_eur + latency_ms, /api/orchestrate/stream terminating 'done' event carries cost_estimate_eur + latency_ms, /api/telemetry shape (totals + by_model + recent) and it truly increments the requests counter after a fresh /orchestrate call, GPT-5.2 cost > Gemini 3 Flash cost for identical prompt (validated by force_model_id), GridFS migration end-to-end (Mongo doc for image_generation stores images[].gridfs_id and NOT inline data_url, GridFS files collection ai4life_images.files holds the real bytes, GET /sessions/{id}/messages hydrates back to a data:image/... URL with byte length exactly matching the stored GridFS length), DELETE /sessions/{id} removes the GridFS files (chunks/files no longer contain the ids), backward-compat: legacy inline data_url docs (from iter3) still hydrate via /messages, services/db.py has exactly one AsyncIOMotorClient() instantiation (history + telemetry both import from .db, neither creates its own client), server.py uses lifespan asynccontextmanager and no @app.on_event references, no on_event DeprecationWarning in supervisor logs. Regression: /api/models still returns 5, /api/orchestrate 400 on empty, /api/sessions returns list, /api/compare returns 2 results both ok=true. Frontend E2E via Playwright: nav-telemetry renders telemetry-view with kpi-requests, kpi-cost, kpi-latency, telemetry-by-model, telemetry-recent (all visible with real data). recipes-strip in chat view shows 8 chips; clicking recipe-code-review fills prompt-input with 'Fai una code review...' and toggles the chip active (sky highlight); recipe-cyberpunk-moodboard fills prompt with 'Genera immagine...' AND activates style-cyberpunk + style-photorealistic. After firing a normal chat request, response-card renders and cost-badge appears with format like '<€0.0001· 1563ms'. Telemetry auto-refresh verified: while sitting on telemetry-view, sending a request from chat and returning increments kpi-requests within one 5s refresh cycle (9 → 10 → 11 across two runs). MediaRecorder capability sniffing verified by deleting window.MediaRecorder and clicking voice-btn → toast 'Registrazione audio non supportata da questo browser' appears; no crash.

minor.issue: gemini-3-flash entry in config/models_registry.json does not declare cost_per_1k_output_tokens_eur nor cost_per_image_eur — it silently falls back to the cost_efficiency-derived formula in telemetry.estimate_cost_eur(). Tests still pass because the review spec allows the fallback, but the docstring claims 'added cost_per_1k_output_tokens_eur and cost_per_image_eur to all 5 models'. Only 4/5 have both fields explicitly.

action_items: (Housekeeping only) Add explicit cost_per_1k_output_tokens_eur + cost_per_image_eur to the gemini-3-flash model entry in models_registry.json to match the iter4 spec (currently derived from cost_efficiency=95 via fallback).

(Housekeeping) The older test_iteration2.py::TestVersion and test_iteration3.py::TestVersion still hard-assert 1.1.0 / 1.2.0. They will now fail against the bumped 1.3.0 product. Not a regression — same class of stale assertion flagged in iter3 report. Consider centralising the version assertion in backend_test.py::TestRoot only.

(Housekeeping) Minor pytest deprecation warning: class-scoped fixture is defined as an instance method in TestGridFSMigration (PytestRemovedIn10Warning). Not blocking; convert to @classmethod when convenient.
critical_code_review_comments: services/telemetry.py::estimate_cost_eur() — when cost_per_1k_output_tokens_eur is missing (gemini-3-flash today) the fallback derives 0.02 * (100-95)/100 = 0.001 EUR/1K tokens, which is why Gemini is ~50x cheaper than GPT-5.2 in tests. This is fine for FinOps signalling but the price is symbolic, not the actual Gemini list price. Consider making all 5 models declare explicit pricing to remove reliance on the fallback.

services/history.py::_hydrate_message() — swallows GridFS read exceptions silently (continue). If a GridFS blob is deleted out-of-band, the client will see an image message with images[] = [] with no visible error. Consider surfacing a sentinel 'broken image' or logging a warning so this doesn't fail silent in prod.

services/history.py::save_turn() — image upload failures 'skip that image rather than crash the whole turn' via a bare except. That is defensively fine, but the caller (orchestrator) then persists doc.has_images=false while the API response still returned images=[...] to the client. UI and DB view will diverge on reload. Consider logging + reporting num_failed_images.

services/history.py::delete_session() — GridFS delete errors are swallowed (except: pass). If GridFS clean-up fails, orphaned chunks accumulate silently. Add logging so the operator sees clean-up failures.

services/telemetry.py::log_turn() — try/except swallows all telemetry write failures. That is correct (never break the user path), but there is no log line at all — you cannot debug why telemetry is empty. Log at WARNING level.

services/telemetry.py::get_summary() — computes totals from an already-projected by_model list. On the first request the by_model list has one entry, and this recomputation is correct. But avg_latency in totals is computed as sum(m.avg_latency_ms * m.requests) / total_requests — which is fine only if avg_latency_ms is exact. It is `int(avg or 0)` cast in the pipeline result, so per-model rounding to int can drift the totals by a couple of ms. Cosmetic, not a bug.
server.py::lifespan — good migration to asynccontextmanager. The startup branch is empty (yield first, then close_db()). If you later add e.g. index creation, remember it goes before the yield.

services/db.py — clean single-client pattern, but note `close_db` calls `client.close()` synchronously; Motor's close is fire-and-forget so this is safe, but consider `await` compatibility if the SDK changes.
config/models_registry.json — gemini-3-flash is the only model missing cost_per_1k_output_tokens_eur + cost_per_image_eur. Recommend adding explicit values to match the iter4 spec.
config/recipes.json — 8 recipes are well-shaped. weights_hint always sums to 1.0 exactly, styles is [] for text intents. No issues.

frontend/src/components/Telemetry.jsx — auto-refresh interval is created once per mount, cleared on unmount. Correct. Only concern: on rapid nav in/out (React strict mode double-mount in dev), a second interval may briefly co-exist; harmless in prod build.

frontend/src/components/VoiceButton.jsx — capability sniffing correctly guards `typeof window.MediaRecorder === 'undefined'`. Nice fix. On Safari that supports MediaRecorder but only audio/mp4, the mimeType fallback chain (webm → mp4 → default) works. Confirmed manually by clicking voice-btn under a synthetic `delete window.MediaRecorder`.

frontend/src/components/RecipesStrip.jsx — uses `Icons[r.icon] || Icons.FileText`. This means any typo in a recipe icon name silently falls back to FileText; verified all 8 recipe icons resolve today. Consider warning in dev if icon lookup fails.

frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.jsx — applyRecipe() sets pendingWeightsOverride, then handleSubmit() consumes it and clears it before the request. If the user applies a recipe but never submits, the pending override lingers in state until the next request. That's fine as long as the next submit is intended to use it. If a stale recipe hint is undesired after N minutes, consider clearing it after a timeout.

frontend/src/components/CostBadge.jsx — display formatter thresholds `<€0.0001`, `toFixed(4)` under €0.01, `toFixed(3)` at or above €0.01. Numerically correct. Screen reader sees only 'Costo stimato: €0.0002 · Latenza reale: 1563ms' via the title attribute; consider aria-label for accessibility.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all iter-4 UI acceptance criteria verified: nav-telemetry + telemetry-view KPIs + by_model + recent, recipes-strip 8 chips, recipe-code-review fills prompt + toggles active, recipe-cyberpunk-moodboard fills prompt + activates cyberpunk + photorealistic style presets, cost-badge on response-card with ⚡€… format, telemetry auto-refresh 5s incremented kpi-requests without navigation, MediaRecorder=undefined path shows non-supportata toast without crash)

rca of the issue: No blocking issues in iteration 4. Only cosmetic finding: gemini-3-flash entry in models_registry.json is missing explicit cost_per_1k_output_tokens_eur + cost_per_image_eur, so telemetry.estimate_cost_eur() takes the cost_efficiency-derived fallback path (0.001 EUR / 1K tokens). This produces a very small but non-zero cost that satisfies the 'Gemini cheaper than GPT-5.2' invariant. The iter4 spec says all 5 models have both fields — recommend adding them to gemini-3-flash for consistency. Stale version assertions in iter2/iter3 test files are the same class of expected-stale flagged in the iter3 report and require no product change.
